description: This file is a script that analyzes TypeScript source code to detect deprecated API calls, specifically the 'registerHttpHandler' method, and provides guidance for migration to newer APIs. It imports utilities for AST processing and performs static analysis on source content.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Determines if a given call expression is a call to the deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' method.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses a source content string to locate lines where 'registerHttpHandler' is called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initiates the scanning process and outputs results.
